'''Jedi Heritage “Go Towards The Light..........SABER!!!”''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jedi Heritage]]
* '''Published:''' 7 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed WHT Heritage LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Okay....This is one of my own creations. It basically is a lightsaber combat deck, with a

few extra fun things thrown in along with it!

== Strategy ==

My strategy is not very complicated at all. First, you want to use the objective to get

Naboo: Generator Core, and Naboo: Generator out on the table. Also, put out The Signal

so you can pull out Traffic Control and be free to recycle petty cards back into your

Reserve deck. Also, you want to put out Inner Strength. Continue on the game, and try to get Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan out. Equip them with their lightsabers. Now, obtain combat cards like Jedi Escape, Lightsaber Profciency, Higher Ground, and A Jedi’s Patients. These will help in the eliminating any character that decides to come and try to play with you. Put out the Jedi Council Chamber, and have some fun next. With that out, get Yoda from your Reserve deck. Then use Speak To The Jedi Council to get any other episode 1 Jedi out onto the table. Basically your force drains will not be cancled, and then you can get out you other Jedi and wreak havoc!! The other cards, like the non-Jedi and the starships, are there to help in the merry-making! Have fun with this deck!! I know that I

have and will!!!!
